exact_items: Plans/Provider_OpenCode.md needs immediate correction of canonical/session identity ownership
OpenCode still misuses canonical thread_id for provider-native session identity
Move OpenCode session IDs into provider-native correlation fields
notes: OpenCode session ID is still being treated as if it were canonical PM thread_id

exact_items: Plans/CLI_Bridged_Providers.md needs a versioned correlation/context block and account-health semantics stronger than auth lifecycle alone
Add a versioned stream/provider correlation block for actor/attempt/account/trust metadata
Bridged contracts still cannot legally carry all correlation/account/trust metadata their addenda already imply
Plans/Provider_Stream_Mapping_External_Reference_A2A.md needs stream version governance before actor/account/trust semantics can be added cleanly
A2A still blocks clean category growth despite rewrite-era semantics needing first-class stream representation
Add explicit versioning/migration notes where A2A or bridged categories/fields must grow
Plans/Permissions_System.md needs scope-keyed approval semantics and richer permission snapshots
Permission approval caching and reject-cascade still lack actor/lane/account scope
Permission snapshots still do not project requested/effective identity richly enough for blocked/approval truth
Upgrade permission snapshots to carry requested/effective values, downgrade reasons, and identity context
notes: ask/plan -> deny still conflicts with external_publish_side_effect non-bypassable approval path

exact_items: Plans/Contracts_V0.md and Plans/storage-plan.md are likely owners for canonical blocked/approval identity linkage and pressure/switch projection families
Reconcile ask/plan and external_publish_side_effect semantics in one canonical algorithm
Define an Approval Scope Key spanning actor/lane/run/account context
Add execution_role to effective-resolution record, attempt_record, tier_runtime_record or successor, and usage_record
Add operational-identity blocks to runtime records where side-effectful or externally-scoped actions matter
Operational identity kinds: github_api_account, registry_namespace, kubernetes_context
Ensure GUI inspectors can show requested/effective provider/account identity, requested/effective operational identity, execution role, and selection/switch reason
notes: execution_role is not the same as run_kind; operational identity is not the same as provider account identity

exact_items: Add a canonical append-only event/record family for account-pressure and switching: account_pressure_episode and account_switch_event

account_pressure_episode fields: episode_id, project_id, provider_id, account_id, execution_role?, source_kind, signal_confidence, pressure_kind, projected_remaining?, reset_at?, started_at_utc, updated_at_utc, ended_at_utc?, status

account_switch_event fields: switch_event_id, project_id, provider_id, execution_role?, requested_account_id?, from_account_id?, to_account_id?, switch_reason, decision_kind, source_episode_id?, run_id?, attempt_id?, thread_id?, ts
notes: Current account_switch_reason does too much work as a single field; notification copy already assumes switch outcomes that have no canonical durable event family behind them
